boe.name: Bank of England Base Rate
boe.change_basis: size of the last Bank of England decision
boe.source: Bank of England, Bank Rate history

fed.name: US Federal Funds Rate
fed.change_basis: size of the last Federal Reserve decision
fed.source: Federal Reserve target range, via FRED (DFEDTARU, DFEDTARL)

euribor.name: EURIBOR 3-Month
euribor.change_basis: move since the previous daily fixing

notes: Change for the Fed and Bank of England is the size of the last policy decision; for Euribor it is the move since the previous daily fixing.
